reviews.text: A welcoming, pet-friendly atmosphere, a well-kept swimming pool, and dozens of different dogs running around under the watchful eyes of the dog trainers.
Beautiful experience, everything super organised, very clean environment, thank you

Beautiful and peaceful experience. It was the little one's first time, but he slowly got used to it.
Clean place, friendly staff, and lovely guests.
Everything was perfect.

We had a really great time at the DKO pool! Maya was welcomed with care, kindness, and professionalism. The staff are qualified, helpful, and know how to interact with dogs, respecting their time and needs. It's a pleasant and safe environment, which I happily recommend to anyone who wants to take care of their dog's well-being. We'll definitely be back! 🐕💦❤️

P.S. Please read the rules carefully before going, as it's important to ensure the best experience possible and to respect everyone.
Beautiful and welcoming place, apart from too many mosquitoes and a few broken sunbeds!
A wonderful experience, very well organized and well-kept. I highly recommend it for a day with your dog! We'll definitely be back!
A wonderful experience with our CLC. Welcoming facility, helpful staff, and a relaxing time for families with a puppy.

A wonderful place.
An unexpected surprise... a pool for dogs and humans that rivals that of a 5-star club.
Spotlessly clean, with staff always attentive to ensuring guests follow the rules and a warm welcome.
A well-stocked bistro, offering both savory and sweet treats (the ice cream is second to none).
And then... as soon as my dog ​​sees me packing his training bag, he starts barking until he reaches the water...
He's addicted, he has so much fun... Yes, because in addition to the summer pool, there's a full-fledged indoor gym with a pool for diving, aqua trails, and water aerobics, complete with changing rooms, a grooming area with a kennel, and a tub for washing and drying dogs.
What more can I say?
Congratulations to the creator of this oasis.

🤩 I love this place! 5 well-deserved stars!

A large, welcoming, and functional facility, designed to meet every need of both dogs and their human companions. 😊

I've been coming to the center since it opened, and year after year, it's wonderful to see how the facility continues to grow and improve, thanks to the experience, professionalism, and passion of Valeria and her entire team.

Janis has never been a big fan of water, but with a lot of patience and the instructors' valuable advice, we managed to find the perfect activity for her: freestyle!

Even Amy, with her ever-present life jacket, is learning to overcome her fears and indulge in a few short swims in the play pool. 😁

For us, it's now a true point of reference, a place we always return to with great pleasure and where we know our dogs are cared for with care and expertise.
Highly recommended! 🥰

Highly not recommended. The staff was nonexistent, and the only girl there was completely lacking in empathy, first toward the dog and then toward us. She scolded us repeatedly without giving the dog time to adjust, despite us having told her she was very fearful. We asked for a life jacket, and she told us she'd already given one to another dog and only had one small one. So, at most, we could do a little for each dog. On their website, they try to sell you a dog training center where everything is done to entertain your dog, but in the end, the staff is just one grumpy person who only cares about smoking and doing her own thing. So much so, that as soon as two dogs got into a nasty fight, she arrived after it was all over. At our place, she was running. We stayed for an hour and a half, and they wouldn't even give us a refund right away! Call it a dog pool! A dog training center is something else entirely, and a far cry from what you offer!
PS. Her detailed response, in which she went to great lengths to deny the truth, which her husband admitted to me, including the dog fight, and for which he gave me the refund she had denied, speaks volumes. And how strange that the review identical to mine from four weeks ago has disappeared.

I frequent the pool house and the indoor pool with my dog, Jacques, a border collie, and sometimes my twelve-year-old daughter for classes. It wouldn't be easy to manage such a specialized facility without preparation, awareness, and passion. I find these qualities in the staff and in the organization of the space and the center. It was the most extraordinary discovery of this year, an ideal place for a summer in Rome and the discovery of Jacques's aptitude and passion for water. Truly, top marks.

A place I've been waiting to discover for a long time. Well organized and impeccably managed by the staff, who are always present, kind, and helpful. Finally, a place where you can swim with your pet in complete safety, as part of the pool is shallow, making it suitable for even the most timid of dogs. Everything is organized down to the smallest detail, and the food at the restaurant is excellent. A great place to spend a peaceful day.

Today was my first time at this wonderful place. It was my dog ​​Pippo's first swim, and he's very timid. I met some really qualified people who gave me advice on what to do. The gentleman who also showed us the large indoor pool where they do lessons and agility activities was very kind. The place is very beautiful and clean. I'll be back soon because I loved it so much.

I went to the center, but the experience was incredibly disappointing. There was a so-called trainer who forbade my dog ​​from any kind of activity, not even moving, despite us telling her she was a fearful dog and needed time to adjust. Other dogs were fighting a little further away, but she was more interested in scolding us.

After an hour and a half, we ran away.

If this is empathy for dogs, we're in trouble!!!

A truly wonderful experience at the DKDog Roma water park! Maddie had a blast, and we felt welcomed from the very first moment. Special thanks to Vanessa, the bartender: very kind, helpful, talented, and always ready to help with a smile. 💕
Thanks also to trainer Amodio, very attentive and professional, who took so many wonderful photos of Maddie throughout the day, giving us truly special memories. 🐾📸
A well-kept, pleasant, and perfect place to spend a different day with your dog. We had a wonderful time and will definitely be back! Highly recommended! ❤️
Here, dogs are finally the stars ♥️
Very nice and well-kept place, but the prices are exorbitant....you could make it accessible to everyone by moderating the prices...

FANTASTIC EXPERIENCE 🌟
Our French bulldog, Lady, had a blast in the pool at the Pool House Dog Water Center.
The place is well-maintained and perfectly organized, and the staff is incredibly kind and available to meet every need.
A truly wonderful discovery, we'll definitely be back!
It's a quiet place, the trainers are very knowledgeable and always ready to give advice, a very nice place to be with your furry friend.

An incredible experience for anyone who has a four-legged friend at home, a super-equipped place for both animals and bipeds 😅, a well-stocked bar and lunch in absolute tranquility, highly recommended …

It's a beautiful place, very well-kept and clean...to spend a day in the water with our furry friend...highly recommended!!!
The owner is helpful, polite, and knowledgeable about dog handling...Top 👍👍👍 …
Thank you!!!! Beautiful day and excellent organization!

Unfortunately, my experience wasn't a positive one. The place is very nice, but I was unlucky with the staff. When I arrived, I was treated rudely; I hadn't even entered before they scolded me for how my dog ​​should behave. I assure you, I hadn't done anything yet, but I was waiting for my spot. Later, a dog pooped very heavily near my umbrella. I went to report it, but they didn't take me into account. It's strange, because they had previously scolded me if my dog ​​pooped, which he didn't. Unfortunately, they came 30 minutes later to clean up, at which point I was forced to leave, along with my son and the dog. I have nothing against the dog pooping, but I definitely won't be returning due to the staff's poor organization.

It's our first time there. The staff is lovely, kind, and very helpful. The place is well-maintained and organized, the pool is very clean, and - following a few simple rules of good coexistence - the experience is enjoyable. The food is also worthy. I'd say it's a great place to bring our four-legged friends for a few hours of play and exercise.

I rarely leave reviews, but this place deserves five stars, and it's right that people know it. The staff is helpful and polite. Every detail is taken care of to ensure the best possible experience. Well done!

The facility is clean and well-organized, with all passages between the various areas gated. Staff are always present poolside, ready to offer professional advice to owners of dogs who aren't keen on swimming, but never in a invasive manner. While the rules may seem too stringent for some, they allow everyone (people and dogs) to have a wonderful day.
We came here for the first time today, and it was a positive experience. We'll definitely be back. The place is well-kept and the staff are very friendly. 👍❤️🐶 …

The atmosphere is refined and functional, with everything you need to spend the day with your pets. The bistro is excellent for lunch.
I'll definitely be back!

I went for the first time yesterday with my partner and my French bulldog.
The atmosphere is refined, comfortable, and well-organized. Truly a wonderful discovery. I'll definitely be back!
Simply fantastic, clean, well kept, swimming in the pool with your dog is a splendid idea.
Friendly staff, well-maintained and clean center. Despite a mix-up with the booking, they resolved the issue quickly.
A wonderful day, even with the kids. The dog had a blast, and so did we. The staff were incredibly kind and helpful, and the experience was very good! I highly recommend it.
Beautiful, clean,
Today I was with my husband and my daughter and we had a great time❤️
??? So to understand who you are, with this name, it shows that you have been here at least once.

A top-notch aquatic dog training center, everything is perfectly organized and clean.
The instructors are highly trained and available.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
Beautiful

A private and relaxing setting in the heart of Rome where you can spend a day in harmony with your four-legged friends, including doggie diving platforms. The pool is well-maintained, and the "Cane Giallo" bistro offers quality food. The staff is extremely friendly and attentive, a true gem in the heart of Rome. Highly recommended!

One word: SPECTACULAR.
Cleanliness, kindness, attention to every detail, a spectacular place to relax with your four-legged friend, excellent food and a wide selection.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED.

A haven of happiness for dogs and their owners 🐾.
A peaceful, fun, and safe environment. My dog ​​went home relaxed and very happy. We'll definitely be back! …
Beautiful experience with my Nala we had a great time I recommend it it is an excellent pool for our furry children where they can have fun and spend a wonderful day

“If going to the pool house seems like too much of a chore because you have to take care of your dog, maybe it's not the place for you.” THIS IS THE BEST QUOTE IN THE WHOLE OF DADDY, I confess I stopped halfway.

Unfortunately, most people won't come; they'd rather take their kids to the beach, the park, or the mall and do whatever they want, waiting for someone to pick up their dog's poop.
A unique experience! Our Labrador had a great time in complete safety. Everything was spotless and meticulously cared for. Thanks again for your hospitality, we'll be back soon!

A perfect venue for a sunny day for both dog and their human! The facility is super well-maintained and comfortable, with an excellent little cafe for drinks and food. The pool is segmented into a shallow waddling pool that is great for most dogs. It’s deep enough for them to swim whilst being shallow enough for you to comfortably walk around with them. The other end of the pool is much deeper and suitable for divers.

There is a well thought out loo and shower system that keeps it comfortable when your dog needs a poo break. Loungers were comfortable and the area is not too crowded (although we went during ferragosto).

The price feels a tiny but steep for a half day (€40 for two people and 1 dog), but I would gladly return!
